replication.target_description: Jaeger et al. accepted manuscript, DOI 10.1016/j.joep.2018.11.004; NYC Airbnb host perceived trustworthiness predicting listing price. Relationship located, but specific regression model unresolved.

es.location: Manuscript p. 11, Confirmatory analyses; p. 12, Table 3; pp. 14–15, extended model and Table 4

notes:
Only es_value_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Document title, authors and DOI match the assigned replication reference; supplied version is the accepted manuscript dated 19 November 2018. The description identifies the predictor and price outcome but does not identify the covariate/model specification. Several models report this relationship. The supplied p. 4 locator is a background page in this accepted manuscript, not the results page, and no PDF or alternate paginated source is supplied. Neither row order nor numeric matching was used to select a model. Candidate printed coefficients: Model 1 narrative β = -0.0036, t(1,010) = -0.76, p = .45 (p. 11); Table 3 trustworthiness Model 1 = -0.004, Model 3 = -0.005, Model 4 = -0.004 (p. 12). Table 4 Model 5 = -0.006, Model 6 = -0.012 * (p. 15). Extended Model 6 narrative β = -0.012, printed t(1,002) = 2.32, p = .021 (p. 14); the printed positive t sign is retained despite the negative coefficient. No replication experiment on guest host choices is reported in this source; price is the analyzed proxy for preferences. Metric evidence, manuscript p. 9: Price, median local rent, and number of reviews were log10-transformed due to their
skewed distributions and all continuous variables were z-standardized. Printed β retained as β in candidate descriptions; no conversion to unstandardized b, fully standardized beta, or another metric was performed. No analytic N was assigned or derived. No PDF rendering was possible because source_pdf_path is null.
